sentences.text: Never break stone beneath the old olive trees after midnight in Greece.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Workers hammered at the ancient rock, and the heavy earth cracked open wide.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: From the dark fissure, a creature with iron teeth and twisted horns climbed out.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Long ago, the terrified villagers made a pact to feed the beast once a year.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Tonight the price falls due, and heavy footsteps echo up the dirt pathway.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Open the heavy wooden bolt and let me in right now.
sentences.speaker: mimic

sentences.text: Claws struck the oak wood, shattering the panels in one brutal motion.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Silence swallowed the street, leaving only a dark smear across the stone floor.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Can you hear that heavy breathing right outside your bolted bedroom door tonight?
sentences.speaker: narrator
